title: Rounding off
goal: I can round whole numbers to the nearest 5, 10, 100, 1 000, 10 000 and 100 000.
teach: Find the two round numbers the number lies between. Look at the digit just to the right of the place you round to. If it is 5 or more, round up. If it is 4 or less, round down. A number exactly halfway rounds up.
tvis: 4 638 is closer to 4 600 than to 4 700. To the nearest 100 it rounds to 4 600.

steps: The ten thousands digit is 8, so the number lies between 4 680 000 and 4 690 000.
Look at the digit to its right, the thousands digit: it is 2.
2 is 4 or less, so round down: 4 680 000.

watch: When you round a 9 up, it carries. 39 600 to the nearest 1 000 is 40 000.

qs.steps:
1. Rule: round to the nearest multiple of 5 (numbers ending in 0 or 5).
2. (a) 76 is between 75 and 80 and closer to 75.
3. (b) 254 is between 250 and 255 and closer to 255.

qs.hint: Look at the ten thousands digit.
qs.steps:
1. Rule (rounding): look at the digit to the right of the place you round to: 5 or more rounds up.
2. It lies between 2 800 000 and 2 900 000.
3. The ten thousands digit is 4, so round down: 2 800 000.

qs.text: Round 39 960 to the nearest 100 and to the nearest 1 000.
qs.hint: Rounding 39 960 up carries into the ten thousands.
qs.steps:
1. Rule (rounding): look at the digit to the right of the place you round to: 5 or more rounds up; less than 5 rounds down.
2. Nearest 100: tens digit 6, round up: 39 960 → 40 000
3. Nearest 1 000: hundreds digit 9, round up: 39 960 → 40 000
